questions.q: Who was Amos among before he prophesied?
questions.evidence: The words of Amos, who was among the herdsmen of Tekoa, which he saw concerning Israel in the days of Uzziah king of Judah, and in the days of Jeroboam the son of Joash king of Israel, two years before the earthquake

questions.q: "Do two walk together, unless they have" done what?
questions.evidence: Do two walk together, unless they have agreed
